name: gdc-ctsp-dlbcl1
alternateName: CTSP Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL) CALGB 50303
description:
What makes this cohort worth knowing about is not its size but its provenance. The samples come from CALGB 50303, a randomized phase III trial comparing dose-adjusted EPOCH-R against R-CHOP as frontline therapy for diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. Molecular data collected inside a randomized trial are scarce: treatment assignment is not confounded with patient characteristics, which is the assumption that almost every observational treatment-response analysis has to make and cannot verify.
Vital status is informative for 100% of the 45 cases and median follow-up is 60.4 months. RNA sequencing covers 44 cases, exome 44 and a targeted panel all 45.
citeAs: Dose-Adjusted EPOCH-R Compared With R-CHOP as Frontline Therapy for Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma - Clinical Outcomes of the Phase III Intergroup Trial Alliance/CALGB 50303

supportedQuestions: Do molecular subtypes of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma predict differential benefit from dose-adjusted EPOCH-R versus R-CHOP?
How well do molecular classifiers built on observational DLBCL cohorts perform on uniformly treated trial patients?
What is the five-year survival experience of genomically characterized DLBCL patients treated in a controlled setting?

blockingLimitations.statement: 45 cases is small for any genomic analysis and very small for a treatment-interaction question. Split by trial arm the groups are around twenty patients each.
Treatment fields are populated for only 6.7% of cases in the GDC records, and trial arm assignment is not present at all, even though the cohort comes from a randomized trial.

inappropriateUses: Claiming a treatment interaction without obtaining arm assignment.
